title: Retinues
description: Retinues and its Coop fork, feature by feature: a clan's and a kingdom's troops, the editor's edits (names, looks, skills and their caps, gear, equipment sets and their battle rules, upgrades), retinue conversion, rank-ups and joining by renown, special troops, unlocks from kills, discards and a captured ruler, volunteers and Recruit Anywhere, battle XP, save and reload, and in single player doctrines, the global editor, timed training and import and export (in Coop: off, and the player is told; purge is refused). In Coop, both sides then hold the same troops.
